name: Joshi Astral #3776
description: Joshi Astral #3776 — The Steady Garden. Presented by The House of Joshi. A keeper of quiet beginnings, finding possibility in the places others pass by. Its lavender stone form belongs to the earth family. It wears the sleepy expression and carries the celestial motif of Venus. Patience is a kind of strength. Taurus — The Steady Garden — is one of The Celestial Twelve, with one edition assigned to this sign. The Lissajous overlay is generated from mathematical rules, with its exact parameters recorded in the edition manifest.
